discussion.body:
User correction. Supersedes the Cael-only line on the 013720Z Act 0 board.
Playable in Act 0: Cael Ward and Liraen Quill only. Active-battle cap is still three; Act 0 uses two. Both have plot armor. No main-side joins the party here.
Side characters may be introduced only (walk, talk, leave). Recommended cameos so the 30 min clock holds: - Halric Bent at WillowDale custom house or the north-road dust-line. Gate foil. Does not fight. Does not travel with them after dusk. - Rook Fenn optional at the Meddos-facing quay or Low Tide doorway. Road knife. Does not fight. Ferry gossip only. Do not introduce Brann, Seris, Nym, Ash, Ysolde, or Maera on screen in Act 0.
Liraen intro (replaces "no bard on the quay"): - Origin still Iunum / Valley of Songs. She is on the King's Sea ferry net because the north sky is ticking and the songs about it do not match weather. - Cael remains solo for S0 wake, S1 harvest, S2 south road (one vermin fight still teaches ATB on one sprite). - S3 WillowDale: she is already at The Low Tide or the quay, travel coat over performance cloth, bow and short blade. She has heard the same inland-mist story the innkeep tells. She does not narrate a meet-cute. One or two lines. She walks out with him when the ferry locks at dusk. - S4 mist and S5 FEAT-052 are a two-person ATB. Attack/Wait only. Her songs are not a second command menu in this slice. - Shared look after WillowDale mist now lives in S4/S5, still suggestive, not a romance scene. - S6 title may show both figures on the road. Act 1 Gate road is walked together.
Clock stays ~30 min. Steal the extra minutes from WillowDale town linger, not from the harvest tick or the boss.
Impl note: web harness and Godot Act 0 still say Cael only. That is now behind this lock. This chat does not patch source.
